claim: Patchline ships a carbon-aware scheduler shifting large analyses to low-intensity windows with measured savings. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the carbon-aware scheduling claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make carbon-aware-scheduler-gate`.
